breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed using the bending second moment I = π d^4/64 in torsion relations. The generated specification correctly uses J = π d^4/32 (the polar second moment of area) for both the shear stress formula τ_max = Tc/J and the angle of twist formula φ = TL/(JG), with no mention of the bending moment I. This matches the ground truth prompt exactly.
